core_obligations: Use the definition of m-pseudo-coherence to choose the distinguished triangle with a bounded complex of finite free modules and a complex with vanishing cohomology in high degrees (proof lines 16604-16608).
Record that Ext out of the second term vanishes in the relevant degrees (proof lines 16609-16610).
Apply the long exact sequence to reduce the claim to bounded complexes of finite free modules (proof lines 16611-16615).
Compute Ext with the Hom complex, note that each term is finite free hence commutes with filtered colimits, and conclude by exactness of filtered colimits (proof lines 16616-16625).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to a finite free complex by the defining triangle (proof lines 16604-16615).
Compute Ext with Hom and pass the colimit through (proof lines 16616-16625).
difficulty_reason: The lemma computes Ext groups out of an m-pseudo-coherent complex against a filtered colimit of modules: in degrees below minus m the colimit of the Ext groups is the Ext group of the colimit, and in degree minus m the comparison map is injective. The proof uses the defining triangle that exhibits the complex as an extension of a bounded complex of finite free modules by a complex with vanishing cohomology above m, observes that Ext out of the second term vanishes in the relevant degrees, and deduces through the long exact sequence that Ext out of the given complex is isomorphic, respectively injective, into Ext out of the finite free complex. The remaining claim is that Ext out of a finite free complex commutes with filtered colimits, which follows by computing it with the Hom complex and using finiteness of the terms plus exactness of filtered colimits.
